title: Choong-Jang

symbol.name: Choong-Jang
symbol.meaning: General Kim Deok-ryeong · ITF pattern 14 of 24

note.p: Choong-Jang is the pen name given to General Kim Deok-ryeong of the Joseon (Yi) dynasty. The pattern ends with a left-hand attack for the tragedy of his death in prison at 27, before he could reach full maturity. You start in close ready stance A in the middle of the A–B line facing D: side front blocks in sitting stance and a slow angle punch; double finger thrusts, a back fist, rising block and punch down toward D; a low kick and fingertip thrust, then a turning kick and punch from the ground; elbow thrusts, guarding and scooping blocks back toward C; a knee kick and side kick; back hand strikes into the palm; back fist strikes with the elbow into the palm; reverse knife-hand blocks and 9-shape blocks; twin knife-hand and arc-hand strikes with front kicks toward C; twin fore-knuckle punches; then low blocks and open fist punches to B and A.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (52 movements; the high front block and back fist strike of 25 are split into -1 and -2 here). The A–B line with the start is at the top. The moves along the C–D line (4–47) go back and forth, so they are drawn in order, read down the page in rows along the stem; the minimap shows roughly where each one is. Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right. Finish by bringing the left foot back to the ready posture.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the A–B line facing D in close ready stance A.
Move the right foot to A into a sitting stance facing D. Right inner forearm side front block, the left forearm extended down to the side.
In the same stance, left inner forearm side front block, the right forearm extended down to the side.
Bring the right foot to the left foot into a closed stance facing D. Left angle punch, slowly.
Move the left foot to D into a left walking stance. Right double finger high thrust.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Left double finger high thrust.
In the same stance, right back fist front strike.
Step the left foot forward toward D into a left walking stance. Left forearm rising block.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
Move the right foot back toward C, turning counter-clockwise, then slide toward C into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Right low front snap kick toward D, the hands held where they were.
Lower the right foot toward D into a right low stance. Right flat fingertip high thrust.
Drop onto the left knee with both hands on the floor: right high turning kick toward D.
Lower the right foot toward D, still low: right high punch, the left palm pressing the floor.
Move the left foot to D, turning clockwise into a left L-stance facing C (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Left side elbow thrust toward D.
Move the left foot to C, turning clockwise into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Move the right foot to C into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left palm scooping block.
Move the left foot to C into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right knife-hand middle outward strike.
Pivoting on the right foot, turn into a left walking stance facing C. X-fist pressing block.
Low front snap kick toward C with the right knee, pulling both hands in as if catching the opponent's leg.
Lower the right foot toward C into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Slide the right foot to D into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Right side elbow thrust toward D.
Pivoting on the left foot, turn into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Right middle side piercing kick toward D, pulling both hands apart.
Lower the right foot toward D, then pivoting on the right foot turn into a right rear foot stance facing C (left foot forward on its ball). Twin palm pressing block.
Move the right foot to C into a right walking stance facing C. Right outer forearm high front block.
In the same stance, right back fist high side strike toward C.
Pivoting on the right foot, turn into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left flat fingertip high thrust.
Right low front snap kick toward D, the right palm on the back of the left hand.
Lower the right foot toward D, then pivoting on the left foot turn into a left walking stance facing C. Right back elbow thrust toward D, the left side fist on the right fist, slowly.
Pivoting on the right foot, stamp into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left back hand downward strike.
In the same stance, punch the left palm with the right fist.
Stamp the right foot forward toward C into a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right back hand downward strike.
In the same stance, punch the right palm with the left fist.
Pivoting on the right foot, stamp into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left knife-hand middle outward strike.
Slip the left foot forward into a left walking stance facing D. Right back fist high side front strike, the right elbow striking the left palm.
Stamp the right foot forward toward D into a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right knife-hand middle outward strike.
Slip the right foot forward into a right walking stance facing D. Left back fist high side front strike, the left elbow striking the right palm.
Pivoting on the right foot, turn into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Reverse knife-hand low guarding block.
Slip the left foot forward into a left walking stance facing C. Right 9-shape block.
Move the right foot to C into a left L-stance facing C (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Reverse knife-hand low guarding block.
Slip the right foot forward into a right walking stance facing C. Left 9-shape block.
Move the right foot back toward D into a left walking stance facing C. Twin knife-hand horizontal strike.
In the same stance, right arc-hand high strike.
Right middle front snap kick toward C, the hands held where they were.
Lower the right foot toward C into a right walking stance. Left arc-hand high strike.
Left middle front snap kick toward C, the hands held where they were.
Lower the left foot toward C into a left walking stance. Right middle punch.
In the same stance, left middle punch, fast after 46.
Bring the right foot to the left foot into a closed stance facing C. Twin fore-knuckle fist high crescent punch.
Turn 270° counter-clockwise: move the left foot round to B into a left walking stance facing B. Left knife-hand low block.
In the same stance, right open fist high punch.
Move the left foot along the A–B line into a right walking stance facing A. Right knife-hand low block.
In the same stance, left open fist high punch.
